purpose: Official anchors and decision scenarios for tools/projection.py. Every numeric anchor here is copied from a verified row in data/brief_rows.json; no property-specific value, assumption or probability is asserted.
privacy: This file contains no owner, tenant, address, APN, rent, valuation or tax information. Private inputs are supplied by the owner at runtime and are never written into the published site.

scenarios.name: Sell immediately
scenarios.description: Crystallize value before the reported 2030-2035 expiry; removes single-tenant exposure but sells a shortening term and forgoes land optionality.

scenarios.name: Renew / extend early, then hold
scenarios.description: Convert the ambiguous expiry window into a signed longer term; keeps income and land optionality while retaining tenant credit exposure.

scenarios.name: Renew early, then sell with a long term
scenarios.description: Sequence a documented renewal before marketing so a buyer underwrites firm term rather than expiry risk.

scenarios.name: Hold to expiry, then re-tenant
scenarios.description: Retain land but carry vacancy, capital expenditure and re-leasing risk at the weakest point of the term.

scenarios.name: Hold to expiry, then sell vacant
scenarios.description: Remove income before a sale; weakest wealth-preservation path unless land value dominates.

scenarios.name: Refinance and hold
scenarios.description: Leverage amplifies both return and loss on a concentrated, catastrophe-exposed, single-tenant asset.

scenarios.name: Sell and defer tax via a like-kind exchange
scenarios.description: Preserves after-tax capital and allows diversification, but adds strict identification and closing deadlines.

scenarios.name: Partial interest / ground-lease restructuring
scenarios.description: Document-intensive structure; no recommendation without the executed title and lease documents.

scenarios.name: Do nothing / defer
scenarios.description: Passively letting the term decay is the highest-regret path; option notice deadlines are irreversible.

rules: Use only the official anchors above plus owner-supplied private parameters. Never fetch data at runtime.
Any value not published by an official source is an owner-supplied sensitivity and must be labelled OWNER-SUPPLIED, never 'verified'.
Apply the ULA tier to the whole consideration once the price crosses a threshold; the thresholds are indexed annually and must be re-checked at closing.
Do not discount cash flows beyond the official EDD 2033 projection horizon by extrapolating employment or income series.
Report a break-even renewal probability, not a point estimate of value, because no official cap rate or comparable-sale series exists.
Model outputs are computations, not official statistics, and are never published on the website.
